after: The healthcheck subcommand skips all of that; migrate skips validateSecrets and Redis but does connect to Mongo (ConnectToDatabase).

(report blob objects are deleted only by trimGroupBlobs, group deletes, and the orphan cleanup when InsertReportBlob fails)

after: the upload paths set hashes_verified (update handler per uploaded file, create/upload.go, and mongod/create.go via lookupHashesVerified); the presigned path sets it to file.Inline, so only inline feed files are verified and client-PUT files stay false until TUF publish.
